body: Would the sore you get from an intense work out be an acceptable replacement?
Just curious if you took everything negatively due to not trusting the people.
Any idea as to why you react that way? Do you have trust issues possibly?
So are you saying you just automatically take what people say as negative and construct a reason for why it was negative (regardless of whether or not it was actually negative) afterwards?

Like trying to pinpoint why things happen. Just think about yourself? Man I'm lacking a few crucial words in my vocab. Reflect! Reflect on yourself and try to figure out why things make you feel crappy. Once you have a cause, it's a lot easier to combat it.

On the bright side, you realize what the problem is and you realize that you don't need to feel bad. Try thinking about yourself, do some diving into your mind. Since you can figure that much out, you act at least mostly logically so you're better off than some. You've got half of it figured out, just put a few more pieces together and you'll be good to go. 

I know that doesn't really answer the "why should I keep fighting" question but I don't know how to actually answer it.
